summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Viking Holdings Ltd reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting, which is a routine event. The filing details voting outcomes on director elections, appointment of chairman, and auditor appointment, with no mention of any special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change. As a foreign private issuer, the 6-K serves as a current report of shareholder meeting results—equivalent to the U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.07. There are no deal terms, no board recommendations beyond standard proposals, and no structural changes to monitor.
